checks.finding: Exact Met 2020.263.7 Michele Desubleo, 1665–75, registered original DP-21344-001 image and SHA confirmed, not another Allegory of Sacred and Profane Love.

Met describes Guido Reni and ensemble of painter's palette, sculpture fragments, armor, musical instruments, and humanist balance of pleasure/virtue. This is institutional reading and not a quoted personal declaration of Desubleo.
Retain primary 好奇心2 as an invitation to inspect concrete allegorical objects, not the painter's feelings or a prescriptive experience of romantic love.
New Japanese text describes visible winged young figure and grouped objects and carefully attributes philosophical reading to Met; independently phrased without extended translation.
